summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective July 8, 2026. The split reduced outstanding shares from ~8.7 million to ~0.6 million, with cash paid for fractional shares based on the July 8 closing price. No par value, voting rights, or ownership percentages were affected. The common stock continues trading on Nasdaq under symbol RBNE with a new CUSIP. This is a routine capital structure adjustment to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation event.
